description: This file defines the SugarpdfFactory class which is responsible for loading and instantiating specific subclasses of the Sugarpdf class based on module, type, and other parameters. It handles class loading from different paths, instantiation, and fallback logic. The file serves as a factory for creating Sugarpdf objects tailored to different modules and types within the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: SugarpdfFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for loading and instantiating specific Sugarpdf subclasses based on various parameters, handling class loading from different paths, and providing fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: loadSugarpdf
methods.description: Loads and returns a Sugarpdf object based on the given type, module, bean, and object map. It checks for module-specific files, includes them if they exist, or defaults to a base Sugarpdf instance.

methods.name: _buildFromFile
methods.description: Private method that requires a PHP file, determines the correct class, and instantiates it, falling back to the base Sugarpdf class if necessary.

methods.name: _buildClass
methods.description: Private method that instantiates a class with the given name, passing the bean and object map, and ensures it is a Sugarpdf instance, defaulting if not.
